useCase: Identificación de regiones clonadas, duplicación de texturas y encubrimiento de eliminación de objetos
mechanism: Extrae local característica descriptors using SIFT or SURF algorithms, then performs nearest-neighbor matching para identificar duplicate regions. RANSAC filters geometric inconsistencias to confirm true copy-move forgeries.
accuracy: Medium-Alta - 80-90% for copy-move forgeries with minimal post-processing
name: Deteccion de copia-movimiento
parameters: Feature detector: SIFT, Match umbral: 0.75 (Lowe's ratio), Min matches: 10, RANSAC reproj umbral: 5.0
description: Detecta duplicated regions dentro de an image using keypoint matching. AI tools sometimes replicate texture patches, creating detectable copy-move patrones.

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2011). A SIFT-Based Forensic Method for Copy-Move Attack Detection. IEEE TIFS.
Christlein, V. et al. (2012). An Evaluation of Popular Copy-Move Forgery Detection Approaches. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Excellent for detecting cloned regions
• RANSAC filtering reduces falsos positivos
• Can detect scaled/rotated copies
• Well-proven forense technique
limitations:
• Only detecta duplication dentro de single image
• Heavy post-processing can mask copied regions
• Computacionalmente costoso for large images
• May miss very small duplicated areas
